Name: Maid and Alice in Wonderland Outfits
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hWKjRff.png[/img]


These files make it so you can have a maid outfit or an Alice in Wonderland outfit. 


[b]Installation Instructions:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer
[*]Replace the farmer_girl_base.xnb file and the shirts.xnb file with the ones from the download
[/list]
*You can easily create a backup of your original files by renaming it to something silly. I do shirts.xnbOLD for myself.


[b]To use:
[/b]
Just start your game and set your [b]shirt to option 2[/b] for the maid or [b]option 3[/b] for Alice. Next, change your pants color to white (there are 3 color line pickers, make sure the middle one is set to 0 and the last one is set to 99).

Screenshot showing settings for Pants Color:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/28HuLT6.png[/img]
